findings.title: Missing formal DPA and offshore restriction
findings.deviation: The clause mandates compliance with regional laws and restricts transfers outside the cloud environment but does not incorporate or reference a formal Data Protection Addendum (DPA).
findings.impact: AtliQ may face hurdles in allowing its Pune-based team to access data if it is deemed a transfer outside the specified cloud environment without a pre-agreed DPA.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall not transfer Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval.
findings.counterPosition: Execute the DPA/BAA and the sub-agreements first; agree a de-identified offshore route in writing.

findings.title: Payment trigger on invoice date
findings.deviation: The payment period is triggered by the date on the invoice rather than the date the invoice is received.
findings.impact: This slightly reduces the actual time AtliQ has to receive funds if there are delays in delivering the invoice.
findings.quote: TravelHub shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date by wire transfer to the bank account specified on the invoice.
findings.counterPosition: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum).

fine.note: No liquidated damages or delay penalties are included, which is favorable for the supplier.
The 1x fees liability cap is mutual and includes appropriate carve-outs for confidentiality and wilful misconduct.
IP ownership for specific deliverables transfers only upon full payment, and AtliQ retains its background technology.
Termination for convenience requires 30 days' notice and payment for all work performed up to that date.
The indemnity obligations are mutual and focused on relevant third-party claims (IP and data usage).
The confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 3-year survival period.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to 12 months for involved employees.
The 10-day review period with deemed acceptance is within standard parameters.
